title: Manufacturer Warranty Schedule for Mobility Equipment Components
content:
# Manufacturer Warranty Schedule — Mobility Equipment

Each Mobility Equipment class carries a manufacturer warranty per component, in calendar months. The frame warranty, the warranty on the joystick, controller and wiring, the warranty on motors and gearboxes, and the warranty on tires and casters are counted from the delivery date. The battery warranty is counted from the delivery date or from the last battery replacement. The electronics, motor and battery warranties are 0 for manual chairs.

The schedule also gives the shortest interval between coverage-billed battery replacements outside warranty, in calendar months, which is 0 for manual chairs.

## Schedule (calendar months)

| Class | Frame | Joystick, controller and wiring | Motors and gearboxes | Batteries | Tires and casters | Shortest interval between coverage-billed battery replacements outside warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 12 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 0 |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 36 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 0 |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 60 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 0 |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 120 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 0 |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 60 | 12 | 12 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 60 | 24 | 18 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

## Notes on the schedule

- **Starting point.** Every warranty in the table runs from the delivery date, except the battery warranty, which runs from the delivery date or, where there has been one, from the last battery replacement.
- **Manual classes.** K0001, K0003, K0004 and K0005 show 0 for electronics, motors and batteries and 0 for the battery replacement interval.
- **Longest frame warranty.** Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005), at 120 months, which is also the only class with a 12-month tire and caster warranty.
- **Power classes compared.** K0823 and K0856 share a 60-month frame warranty and a 6-month battery warranty; K0856 carries 24 months on the joystick, controller and wiring against 12 for K0823, and 18 months on motors and gearboxes against 12.
